title: Control Artifact Orchestrator — Audit Playbook for Data Location & Retention
creator: Ayesha Banerjee
description: Build an orchestration playbook and lightweight runtime (Control Artifact Orchestrator) that automates collection, bundling, retention enforcement, and audit-ready export of control artifacts for controls tied to data residency and retention. This ticket scopes the PM playbook, acceptance criteria, and high-level ops/engineering integration points. Goal: make it trivial for the Compliance team and auditors to request a timebound snapshot containing all artifacts and proof assertions for a given jurisdiction and control set.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A documented playbook (Confluence) that maps at least 12 SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls to artifact types (logs, policy configs, S3 manifests, KMS audit records, console snapshots) and retention windows per region.

2) End-to-end prototype in staging: invoking the orchestrator for region 'eu-west-1' returns a signed artifact bundle (tar.gz) containing manifest.json, control-mappings.csv, and the collected artifacts for 3 example controls within 45 minutes.
3) Retention policy harmonizer enforces deletion flags in staging for sample S3 buckets and emits retention-change audit records to the audit index.
4) The orchestrator exposes a secure retrieval API and integrates with the existing artifact vault (integration test passing, PR: github.com/redwood-inference/rw-compliance/pull/1287).
5) Playbook includes escalation/runbook for manual review and a checklist for redaction if requested by a customer before export.
6) Security review completed and documented; storage of exported bundles follows KMS-wrapped keys and per-tenant access control in vault.
7) Dashboard telemetry: success rate, average collection time, bundle size and per-control artifact counts visible on console-2025.03 release dashboard.
8) Demo performed with GRC team and Compliance lead; feedback captured and next steps scheduled.

notes: Design decision: exporters will prefer pre-signed artifact links for large binary items to keep bundle size small; small artifacts (<= 5MB) will be embedded in the bundle. We will include a manifest with sha256 checksums and a signed assertion token describing the retrieval query (region, time window, controls).
